definitions.interaction_density: Distinct unordered activity pairs coupled by shared participants/resources or precedence, divided by all distinct activity pairs.
definitions.resource_contention: Activity pairs sharing at least one resource divided by all distinct activity pairs; separate from participant contention.
definitions.unary_slack: Number of legal individual starts after duration, activity/entity windows, releases, deadlines, fixed starts and blocked intervals; excludes precedence and pairwise capacity.

limitations: Generated development sweep levels are coupled, not causal interventions.
Generation cases carry constructed SAT witnesses; this is not the balanced held-out matrix.
No human-written realistic scenarios are claimed.

selection.policy: No selection using model performance; unresolved solver references remain explicitly unresolved in run records
